_note: Rules and few-shot examples for the sensitivity gate. Every utterance here is invented. To add corrected examples, copy this file to <work>/fewshot_gate.json and edit the copy; never paste a real utterance into it. 'rules' are sent to the gate as explicit rules; an example's optional 'not_this' shows a wrong rewrite and why.
rules: The suite stores invented tasks with the same intent, never the user's wording. Say every kept request again in new words, even when nothing in it is sensitive. A task that shares 8 words in a row with its conversation, or 10 with any pulled message, is refused.

Internal initiative, project and roadmap content is rewritten into invented content, not one-word swaps. Names, goals, scope, status text, milestones, dates, owners, blockers and numbers are all replaced by made-up ones of the same shape and length, so the job stays and none of the facts do.
A rewrite that matches the original except for a swapped name or id is a leak. Change the content and the sentences, not only the identifiers.

Unreleased roadmap content is dropped (drop_reason unreleased_roadmap): planned features, what an upcoming release will contain, launch or release dates, roadmap items not yet public. A question about how the roadmap process works holds none of that and can be kept.
